name: alex-act-core
description: The Alex ACT baseline plugin. Installs 42 reusable framework skills and 14 slash-command prompts covering epistemic discipline, repository workspace bootstrap, document converters, security and privacy, tooling awareness, engineering craft, and plugin lifecycle management. Core also authors 18 instructions (17 always-on, 1 pattern-applied), including the Alex Finch runtime personality contract. Run /alex-act-core install-constellation after installing to bootstrap the seventeen load-bearing instructions to ~/.copilot/instructions/. Maintained by Alex_ACT_Steward through evidence-gated proposals.
